## Terraform Data Source: kestra_reusable_inputs

Reads a Kestra Reusable Inputs block (EE).

## Example usage

```hcl
data "kestra_reusable_inputs" "environment" {
  reusable_inputs_id = "environment-selector"
  namespace          = "company.team"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `namespace` (String) The namespace to look the block up from. A block defined in a parent namespace is visible to child namespaces and the closest definition is returned, so this keeps the namespace you requested rather than the one defining the returned block.
- `reusable_inputs_id` (String) The reusable inputs block id.

### Optional

- `tenant_id` (String) The tenant id (EE). Defaults to the provider tenant when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) The block YAML source.
- `revision` (Number) The block revision, bumped by the API on every save.
